notes: Corpus: 96 CHED-P journey traces (subset of the 383-trace IPAFFS corpus). Canonical CREATE order (pages 0-39) is reconciled against tests/accessibility/ched-p-accessibility-tests.spec.ts (walks every create page in order) and workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts; the two full-submit traces 94d29a16 (ROW High risk) and 0a6f82fc (EU High risk) corroborate it action-for-action. Where the LLM pageGuesses were noisy I keyed on URL fragment + page-object name (page-objects/notification/*.ts). Primary evidence trace for the create journey is 94d29a16 (222 steps, no errors) — actionIds are mid-range so the next wave snapshots the page, not the navigate-away click; single-action interstitials/confirmation pages (health-certificate-required, notification-hub, *-confirmation, declaration) unavoidably use their only action and rely on Playwright's before-action snapshot. KEY VARIANTS captured off the linear path (order -1): (1) Transit purpose -> exit-BCP fields on About the consignment; (2) Common User Charge + billing pages (CUC consignments); (3) IUU catch-certificate sub-flow (fishery products, e.g. Anguilla) — catch-certificate-needed/attach/details + 'upload more?' loop; (4) full B2B inspector DECISION journey in the /decision app (documentary/identity+physical/laboratory/conclusion/reason-for-refusal/re-dispatch/submit + record-decision), including override-risk-decision and CHED-overview replace-certificate; (5) LVU/OV record-control in the /control app; (6) border-notification app for rejected CHEDs; (7) post-submission amend and delete; (8) Attachments tab document exchange. UNCOVERED SURFACE (findings, not absences): (a) CsvUploadPage exists in the page objects but the CHED-P corpus never exercises bulk/CSV commodity upload — CHED-P here is single-commodity via commodity-code search; corroborate against templates before ruling out. (b) The commodity flow only ever adds ONE commodity ('No' to add-another) — multi-commodity add-another loop is unexercised. (c) GoodsMovementServices Yes answers (CTC MRN / GVMS reference follow-up fields) are only ever answered 'No' in the create traces; their reveal fields are uncovered. (d) Cloning (clone-certificate-type/clone-search) is present but BROKEN in this corpus (times out) and is an out-of-scope candidate per the CHED-PP precedent — flag for a scope ruling. (e) OriginOfImport 'Does your consignment require a health certificate? No' branch (skips the health-certificate section) is unexercised. Traces are a LOWER BOUND — treat every uncovered branch as a requirement to confirm, not one to drop.
